aliases: literally meaning "continuous attacks of the emperor"
official_definition: Once per turn, this Spirit can battle up to four times in a row. (Before the end of battle, you can carry out another battle from the before-block Flash Timing (Max. 3 times).)

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Emperor Road] or [Emperor Road: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Emperor Road]", "give [Emperor Road]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
